mapper.sql: id, stamps_required, reward_name AS name, reward_description AS description, validity_days
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reward_rules WHERE id = COALESCE((SELECT reward_rule_id FROM loyalty_accounts WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}), (SELECT id FROM reward_rules WHERE active))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rewards (id, customer_id, rule_id, stamps_required_snapshot, reward_name_snapshot, status, earned_at, expires_at, code_nonce, code_lookup, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{ruleId}, #{stampsRequired}, CAST(#{name} AS jsonb), 'AVAILABLE', #{earnedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{codeNonce}, #{codeLookup}, #{earnedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rewards WHERE code_lookup = #{codeLookup})

SELECT id, reward_name_snapshot AS name, status, earned_at, expires_at, redeemed_at, code_nonce FROM rewards WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, earned_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM rewards WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND code_lookup IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE rewards SET code_nonce = #{codeNonce}, code_lookup = #{codeLookup} WHERE id = #{id} AND code_lookup IS NULL
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.code_nonce, r.status, r.reward_name_snapshot AS name, r.earned_at, r.expires_at, r.redeemed_at, r.redeemed_by, r.redeemed_branch_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone_masked, b.name AS branch_name, r.customer_id FROM rewards r JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = r.redeemed_branch_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.code_lookup = #{codeLookup} FOR UPDATE OF r
mapper.update: UPDATE loyalty_accounts SET rewards_redeemed = rewards_redeemed + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
UPDATE rewards SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'AVAILABLE' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now}
